ModFolderDescription: Select the folder where the files to translate are located. It can be the directory where all the mods are, or a specific mod folder.

ModeDescription.0: Manage how the missing translations are handled
ModeDescription.1: Add the missing translations to the current mod folder
ModeDescription.2: Add the missing translations to a new folder, keeping the original structure
ModeDescription.3: Create a single mod in your game mod folder gathering the missing translations of every mod

subtitle: Formerly paradox mod language converter
CheckFilesBeforeCreationDesc: Allows you to view and choose which files will be created
DeepCheckDesc: Instead of just compare existing files, check in existing files if all keys of the source language are present.
DeepCheckWarn: EXPERIMENTAL : use at your own risk, it's very slow

conversionLog.glossary: Glossary from the game: {{terms}} terms, {{strings}} known strings

IdleBreakdown: Skipped: {{noLocalisation}} without a localisation folder, {{noSourceFiles}} without English text, {{upToDate}} where every key is already translated
RunCancelled: Stopped before the end, already created files are kept.
TranslateDesc: Instead of copying the English text, send each line to a translation backend. Markup tokens are checked after every answer: a line that lost a $VARIABLE$ stays in English rather than breaking in game.
TranslateWarn: SLOW: count a few lines per second with a local model. Translations are remembered between runs, so a stopped run resumes where it left off.
BatchHint: Point it at the folder containing all your mods to process them in one run.
SummaryLine: {{created}} file(s) created in {{mods}} mod(s) out of {{scanned}} scanned
NothingToCreate: Nothing to create, every target file already exists.
TranslationModHint: Name of the mod created in your game mod folder. Files are grouped in a subfolder per source mod.
TranslationModLoadOrder: Enable it in the launcher and put it last in the load order.

HowToUseDesc.1: Select your game on the top
HowToUseDesc.2: Select the directory of the mods. It can be the folder of a sigle mod, the directory of the workshop's mods or any folder containing mods
HowToUseDesc.5: Change the options if you need'
HowToUseDesc.6: Wait for the process to finish
HowToUseDesc.7: Check the files that will be created

HowItWorksDesc.1: To explain simply, the tool with check all the the translation files from the source language and check if there are files for the target language(s). If not, it will create them. based on the source language to avoir missing translations.
HowItWorksDesc.2: It help to avoid having keys instead of text if your language is not translated. It will not translate the mod by itself, only generate the localisation files.
HowItWorksDesc.3: If the location file is detected, even if it's incomplete, this app will not overwrite it by default. You can change this behaviour in the options.
HowItWorksDesc.4: In the future you will be able to check missing keys on existing files.

LimitationsDesc.1: I saw multiple mods using exotic folder or file names like "synced_localisation" or "replace". The tool will ignore these folders for now.
LimitationsDesc.2: This tool is mainly tested with stellaris, i've tested it with eu4 and ck3, but with fewer mods/usecase and i've not tested Hoi4, the logic is the same so there should be no problems but for some specific case it may not work. I've disabled imperator rome and victoria for now

GamePathHint: The base game localisation is used as a glossary: its official wording is reused and identical strings are not sent to a model at all.
CoverageHint: Numbers are translated keys out of English keys. A key counts as translated when the mod itself has it, or when a localisation mod depending on it has it.
WrongGameSpelling: No mod holds a "{{expected}}" folder, but {{count}} of them hold "{{other}}" instead. That is another game’s spelling — check the game selected at the top of the window.
WrongGameNoLocalisation: No mod holds a "{{expected}}" folder. Either the wrong game is selected at the top of the window, or this folder holds no mods with text.
